results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

Each summary matches its controlling idea: the opening distinction, widening bottleneck, philosophical explanation, contextual value, how/whether responsibilities, passive-use warning, reconstruction method, practices, self-assessment, and ownership-capacity conclusion all appear in contract order. The introductory callout is retained as evidence with a null paragraph mapping; the reference apparatus is not an additional argumentative paragraph.

Audited all 44 mapped units and the outliner’s sole two_ideas flag. The flag concerns the three-bullet KEY POINTS callout, whose purpose is to summarize multiple claims, rather than a prose paragraph. The dense units remain unified: p31 groups studies and a confidence analogy around passive use, p34 gives three expressions of incremental reconstruction, p35 is one worked process, and p40 is one self-assessment list; no mapped unit requires unrelated controlling ideas.

Audited p01–p44 and the callout against S1–S6. The receiving/understanding distinction (p01–p08, p15–p19) supports S1; the asymmetry and last-mile load (p09–p14, p20–p24) support S2/S3; the how/whether discussion and passive-use warning (p25–p32) support S3/S4; reconstruction (p33–p37) supports S5; practices, questions, and the conclusion (p38–p44) support S6 and synthesize earlier claims. Audited all 48 declared evidence items: p01–p04, p06–p07, p10–p11, p13–p14, p16–p19, p21–p23, p26–p28, p30–p31, p34–p38, and p40–p44. Read the three actual figures and captions, all three comparison/action tables, the opening callout, and quoted source descriptions in To Probe Further. The examples are interpreted: missing design knowledge explains the initial scenario; the queue explains relationships; drill/hole and local-loop analogies explain contextual value; Naur and Willison explain ownership; the studies are connected to passive use and their stated limitations remain in the prose/references. The reconstruction discussion explicitly bridges development principles to learning, supplies the second-server prerequisite, explains the resulting mental model, and distinguishes a learning path from model internals. Audited all 43 internal unit boundaries, including all ten entries into body/conclusion sections, against their declared relationships and carried information. Examples follow the initial distinction; machine/human comparison leads to the bottleneck; the bottleneck prompts the meaning question; contextual value leads to how/whether; the tool-use objection leads through evidence to active reconstruction; the worked process leads to practices and self-assessment; and those questions lead to synthesis and a named next-post problem.
